description: This file defines a controller class LengthClass in the Opencart administrative interface, responsible for managing length class entities, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting length classes within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing length classes in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of length classes with pagination and navigation links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of length classes, primarily called via AJAX or internal routing.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for the list of length classes, including pagination details.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a length class.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the save operation for adding or updating a length class, with validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected length classes, including validation for default or linked products.
